systemd_units.name: enable-linger.service
systemd_units.note: remediation only: installs a oneshot that runs `loginctl enable-linger pi`. Not required where Linger=yes is already set. The real signal is loginctl show-user pi -p Linger, not this unit's ActiveState.

systemd_units.name: pulseaudio-suspend-fix.service
systemd_units.note: one-shot: disables module-suspend-on-idle so USB audio stays visible to JS8Call

pip_packages.note: shared instance is the source of truth; clients must match it
rnsd needs LXMF for on-network interface discovery

pip_consistency.note: the shared instance and every connected client must speak the same RNS RPC protocol; a floor check cannot detect this drift

unit_flags.note: absent backslashes in ExecStart silently drop these; unit still reports active
sanity: ExecStart must point at an rnsd binary
sanity: headless mode and a listening port

never_push_units.name: zerotier-one.service
never_push_units.reason: primary transport to deployed boxes; repo copy is Type=notify vs deployed Type=simple. Overwriting can drop the box off ZeroTier mid-update.

never_push_units.name: novnc-session.service
never_push_units.reason: operator desktop; repo copy adds RuntimeDirectory=1000/0700 not present on deployed units.

release_notes: fix: convergence ran from previous version's code (one-click lag); drop-in path bug
